title: Wavefront: Low-Rank Drafting with Parallel Causal Refinement for Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.31638v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by letting a cheap drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Parallel block drafters such as DFlash and P-EAGLE propose a whole block in one forward pass, but they lose the dependence between tokens in the block; DSpark restores part of it with a lightweight correction head that runs sequentially. Measuring DSpark, we find that this head overrides the base prediction on most slots, so the expensive base readout through the target's full lm_head mostly provides a seed. We therefore propose Wavefront, which follows a simple principle: shrink the base and strengthen the correction head. Wavefront replaces the full lm_head with a learned low-rank base, conditions the correction head on the whole drafted prefix within the same block, and resolves it with a few parallel Jacobi passes. translated_title: Wavefront：面向推测解码的低秩草稿生成与并行因果精炼
translated_abstract: 推测解码通过让一个廉价的草稿模型提出token，再由目标模型并行验证，从而加速大语言模型的推理。DFlash、P-EAGLE等并行块草稿模型可以在一次前向传播中提出整个token块，但它们丢失了块内token之间的依赖关系；DSpark通过一个按顺序运行的轻量级修正头恢复了部分依赖。在测量DSpark时，我们发现该修正头在大多数位置上会覆盖基础预测，因此通过目标模型完整lm_head进行的昂贵基础读取，大多只是起到一个种子（初始猜测）的作用。为此，我们提出了Wavefront，它遵循一个简单的原则：缩小基础部分、强化修正头。Wavefront用学习到的低秩基础取代完整的lm_head，让修正头以同一块内整个草稿前缀为条件，并通过若干次并行的Jacobi迭代对其进行求解。固定的迭代次数预算使得草稿步骤不含数据依赖的控制流，因此我们可以……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Wavefront推测解码方法：用学习到的低秩基础头替代昂贵的完整lm_head，并以整块草稿前缀为条件、通过并行Jacobi迭代精炼的更强修正头来恢复块内token依赖，实现高效且无数据依赖控制流的并行草稿生成。
en_tdlr: Wavefront accelerates speculative decoding by shrinking the base draft head to a learned low-rank projection and strengthening a correction head conditioned on the entire drafted prefix, refined through parallel Jacobi passes for efficient, control-flow-free parallel drafting.
